description: This is an abstract Java class that serves as a base implementation for objects in the OpenMRS system, providing UUID management, equality, hash code, and string representation functionalities.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsObject
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing core object behaviors for OpenMRS objects, including UUID handling, equality, hashing, and string representation.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID string associated with the object.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID string for the object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the uuid field, or defaults if uuid is null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on uuid, class type, and Hibernate proxies.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including class name, hash code, and uuid.
